text_revisions.old: A Canadian historian of gender, migration and class. Gatekeepers investigates how everyday institutions tried to reshape newcomers in Cold War Canada, while keeping immigrant responses and inequalities in view. Her editorial collaborations retain their joint credit.
text_revisions.new: A Canadian historian of gender, migration and class. Gatekeepers examines how everyday institutions tried to reshape newcomers in Cold War Canada, as characterized by Basok and Bastable’s review. Her own 2019 article separately examines women’s activism and negotiated cultural assertions in mediated social-work files, with uneven power and unknown outcomes. Her editorial collaborations retain their joint credit.
